title: I Printed the Vinyl-Cutter Quota After They Ran Stickers on My Code

parts.text: I opened the cutter queue at 2:14 p.m. and forty stickers sat on my numbered code. Intern Jules had run a batch while I was in a meeting. I was thirty, makerspace steward, holding a quota that listed fifty remaining. I photographed the queue, the code, and the board that said ONE LOGIN. Then I printed the quota. At 2:22 the desk pinged Jules. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. Jules repaid the vinyl. Policy now has a second line: CODES ARE NOT SHARED. I keep the printout. The cutter finally looks like an account, not a party.
